scripts.build: node apps/api/node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --config apps/api/prisma.config.ts && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/config/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:api: node apps/api/node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --config apps/api/prisma.config.ts && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/config/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:web: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && node apps/web/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build apps/web --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
